name: rocks
description: Natural rocks: lumpy boulders and tall outcrops from jittered overlapping lobes (never spheres), sunk into the ground with satellite stones, in stone, mossy, granite, sandstone or dark palettes; plus area scattering.
exports: boulder(ctx, { x, y, z, size?: 1-6, shape?: lump|tall, palette?, satellites?, seed? }) — y is the first free cell above ground
scatterRocks(ctx, { x, z, w, d, ground(x, z), density?, maxSize?, palette?, skip? }) → { placed }
